questions.stem: This multi-panel figure traces the paired embryonic pharyngeal (aortic) arch arteries as they remodel into the definitive great vessels seen in the neonate. On the LEFT side, which arch persists to form the definitive arch of the aorta?

choices.text: A drop in left ventricular contractility after delivery

questions.stem: This diagram contrasts the normal respiratory variation in the second heart sound with a pattern that stays widely split and unchanged between inspiration and expiration. The lower ('fixed, wide') pattern is the classic auscultatory sign of which lesion?

explanation.summary: In an ASD the left-to-right shunt equalizes right and left atrial filling across the respiratory cycle, so right ventricular ejection (and thus P2 timing relative to A2) no longer varies with inspiration. This produces a fixed, widely split S2.

questions.stem: This schematic shows fusion of the endocardial cushions and the septa that partition the atrioventricular canal and the ventricles. Failure of the membranous portion forming at the top of the ventricular septum to close results in which defect?

choices.label: B
